name: Stripe homepage — financial infrastructure landing page by stripe.com
description: The page runs a strict two-colour system — white canvas with navy #0A2540 text and blurple #635BFF accents — and lets huge 3D gradient artwork (orange→pink→purple) do the expressive work in the hero, then resets to restraint below. Rhythm alternates down the page: a bento grid of product cards each embedding a real UI screenshot, a full-bleed dark event banner, an airy stat band with a radial particle graphic, photographic case studies, and finally a long navy developer section with node diagrams, animated wave gradients and a code snippet. Hierarchy is carried almost entirely by type scale (60px+ display, 24px section intros, 14px gray captions) and by weight rather than ornament, with pills, 1px borders and gradient washes instead of shadows.
